import os

code='''def transform(grid):
    # Reduce the regular lattice by reading the colored intersections on separator rows.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Identify rows/columns that are separators by dominant repeated separator color.
    sep_rows=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row.count(9)>w//2]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c]==9 for r in range(h))>h//2]
    # Colored marker locations on the separator lattice encode the reduced image.
    # Keep separator rows that carry non-background marker cells and sample the
    # marker at each separator crossing, leaving plain crossings as background.
    rs=[r for r in sep_rows if any(grid[r][c] not in (9,) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=9)]
    cs=[c for c in sep_cols if any(grid[r][c] not in (9,) for r in range(h))]
    return [[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c]!=9 else 1 for c in cs] for r in rs]
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
